consequence.statement: CompositionRevision objects that leave spec.mode unset now default to "Pipeline" instead of "Resources".
consequence.remediation: Set spec.mode explicitly if the previous Resources mode is required.

original.statement: The default of spec.mode in the CompositionRevision v1 schema changed from "Resources" to "Pipeline" for objects that leave it unset.

decision.reason: The CRD validators confirmed that in the v1 schema of CompositionRevision, the spec.mode default changed from "Resources" to "Pipeline". They checked this against the release schema files [ev-30934c6c9b63] and [ev-6e79b5dc61ae]; the excerpts shown are only "---", so the validators are the only proof. Nothing in the evidence says that objects which leave spec.mode unset get rejected, fail or must be migrated. So I can't support a mandatory-work kind, and behavior-change (review) is the strongest kind the evidence allows. The proposed statement only restates the confirmed new default and claims nothing beyond it.
